texte.Traiter les risques auxquels l'organisme: Address the risks the organisation is linked to by a business relationship
texte.Traiter les risques que l'organisme caus: Address the risks the organisation causes or contributes to
texte.Un cadrage qui s'arrête aux systèmes que: A scoping exercise that stops at the systems the IT department bought. The uses that arrived on a team credit card are not in it, and those are the ones that cause trouble.
texte.Un dispositif de réclamation qui existe: A complaints arrangement that exists without being accessible. The document expects a legitimate mechanism through which stakeholders can actually raise matters with the enterprise.
texte.Un désengagement présenté comme la seule: Disengagement presented as the only responsible answer. Leaving can worsen the impact for people and removes the leverage that was left.
texte.Un exercice de cadrage qui dit OÙ les ri: A scoping exercise that says WHERE the risks may be found and where they may be most significant — before any in-depth assessment.
texte.Un rapport qui publie les politiques et: A report that publishes the policies and never the impacts. The document calls for both, and names the system's capabilities, limitations and inappropriate uses.
texte.Un risque dont la réalisation est déjà d: A risk whose occurrence is already documented in a comparable deployment.
texte.Un suivi qui mesure l'activité — nombre: Tracking that measures activity — number of reviews, number of training sessions — and never the outcome for people.
texte.Un système d'IA employé pour déterminer: An AI system used to determine the length of sentences in criminal cases.
texte.Une compensation financière pour le domm: Financial compensation for harm that can be economically assessed — physical or mental harm, lost earnings.
texte.Une cotation sans justification. Le docu: A rating with no justification. The document calls for a CREDIBLE process whose rationale is publicly communicated: a figure with no reason is not one.
texte.Une incidence dont le dommage ne peut pa: An impact whose harm cannot be undone, whatever sum is committed afterwards.
A list of the risks specific to AI.
texte.Une politique IA écrite par la conformit: An AI policy written by compliance and never read by those who build. It exists, it is dated, and it changes no architecture decision.
texte.Une responsabilité attribuée à une fonct: A responsibility assigned to a function that has neither the budget nor the authority to stop a go-live. It will sign whatever is put in front of it.
texte.Une table d'équivalence entre les cadres: An equivalence table between the frameworks.
texte.Une évaluation faite une fois, à la mise: An assessment done once, at go-live, on the version of the day. The provider has changed the model since.
texte.User de son levier sur la ou les relatio: Using its leverage over the business relationship or relationships so that they prevent or mitigate — and building that leverage if it is missing.
texte.User de son levier sur la relation d'aff: Using its leverage over the business relationship — and building it if it is missing. The document names three possible responses: continuing the relationship during mitigation, temporarily suspending it, or disengaging from it.
texte.Votre activité produit l'incidence par e: Your activity produces the impact by itself. The document expects cessation AND remediation: preventing is no longer enough, the harm exists.
texte.Votre activité, combinée à celle d'autre: Your activity, in combination with that of others, produces the impact; or it causes, facilitates or incentivises another to produce it. The document requires the contribution to be SUBSTANTIAL: it does not include minor or trivial contributions.
texte.Vous fournissez ce avec quoi un système: You supply what an AI system is built with: data, annotation, dataset creation and curation, code made available to third parties — contributions to open libraries included —, metrics and evaluation measures. Or the inputs that carry it: capital, digital infrastructure and administrative services (compute, cloud, payment platforms, digital labour platforms, operating systems, app stores, security and enterprise software providers), hardware (semiconductors, network equipment).
texte.Vous utilisez des systèmes d'IA dans vos: You use AI systems in your operations, your products or your services — financial institutions and real-economy enterprises included, including those whose business has nothing to do with AI. The document expects due diligence on those systems to enter your overall due diligence: if the system carries no significant risk, other topics come first.
texte.Vous êtes dans le cycle de vie du systèm: You are in the system lifecycle: planning and design, building the model or adapting an existing model, testing, evaluating, verifying and validating, deploying through whatever channel — including the distribution of open-source software —, operating for customers and monitoring. An organisation that modifies and re-deploys an existing model for its own use is part of it.
texte.ce qui empêche la diligence d'être un ex: what stops due diligence being an annual exercise
texte.l'attente la plus forte du cadre dès que: the strongest expectation in the framework as soon as the enterprise causes or contributes
texte.l'étape qui commande toutes les autres :: the step that governs all the others: with no impacts identified, qualified and prioritised, steps # to # have no object
texte.la part que les parties prenantes peuven: the share that stakeholders can verify
texte.le seul endroit où quelque chose change: the only place where something changes for people
texte.le socle, et celui qu'un système de mana: the foundation, and the one an existing management system most often supplies as it stands
texte.les six étapes de la diligence, l'implic: the six steps of due diligence, involvement in the impact — causing, contributing, being linked — and the four prioritisation factors
texte.États-Unis — NIST AI Risk Management Fra: United States — NIST AI Risk Management Framework
texte.Évaluation approfondie des risques les p: In-depth assessment of the most significant risks
